title: A whole home without unattainable finality

captions.physics: Combining tasks into usable domestic arrangements
captions.energy: Postponing use until everything is complete

meaning: Your domestic support preserves freedom when ready arrangements allow sufficiency to be used and neither demands a faultless final form from familiar convenience.
text: It may matter to you to arrange home so different parts support both as a whole. The World in the physical position of Muladhara appears through completing usable shared arrangements. The World in energy can postpone use until complete final readiness. The Devil in emotions holds to familiar convenience. The two World positions differ: a created result already helps, but requiring everything finished makes pleasure conditional. Both struggle to relinquish favourite comfort and to allow its use without a perfect overall picture.

For example, a convenient resting place is ready, but the full collection of favourite belongings has not been positioned ideally. Until final storage is chosen, an evening there supposedly does not count fully. **Sufficient arrangements can sustain pleasure without faultlessly placing everything familiar.** An understandable manageable place allows essentials to be used now. Both can love belongings and choose their amount without every open question cancelling available domestic convenience and permission to rest peacefully together.

The difficulty is seeking a scheme that preserves everything without future questions. Wholeness becomes a condition impossible to fulfil finally. Support grows when benefit and attachment stay visible together. A ready home can include choice and temporary arrangements: both can recognise enough, discuss favourites’ cost and avoid giving all present life to waiting for perfect final comfort.
